name: Are We There, Yeti?
label: Quest
description: Are We There, Yeti?: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now, I sent some mail to my friends already, telling them that I have a surprise for them. This is where you come in!
I'm going to give you my mechanical yeti, and you need to surprise them by paying each of my friends a visit, turning the yeti on and sending it towards them.
Once you have shown Legacki in Everlook, Sprinkle in Gadgetzan, and Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge, come back and tell me what happened!
Please bring my yeti back to me then, too.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't wait to hear how my friends react!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah! They'll think twice before making fun of my ideas again!
Thanks for your help, friend. I couldn't have had so much fun without you!
